stats.title: How to Make Jeans Look Instantly Elegant

structure.what_is_said: Question: what comes to mind for an elegant outfit? Flowy skirts, cream trousers, chic coats, button-ups - "But I bet you didn't think of jeans." Jeans are seen as too casual, "but that couldn't be further from the truth. In today's video we're revealing the most elegant ways to pair your jeans."

structure.what_is_said: Body shape 3 - pear: hips widest, defined waist, narrow upper body; best high-waisted, straight, wide-leg; dark washes; avoid tight jeans around hips/thighs.

tricks: 1 HOOK (0:00-0:23): question opening over a FULL clip of two women in white (0:00-0:04); then the spoken list is illustrated by product cut-outs that appear ONE PER WORD on white (skirt 0:05, trousers 0:06, coat 0:07, shirt 0:08) with a gap left in the middle that the jeans fill on "jeans" (0:11, fades in over 1 s). Hard cut to caramel+centre on the myth ("too casual", 0:12.8), then 2 panels -> a 4-panel row on "couldn't be further from the truth" (0:15-0:17). "In today's video" is literally written on a white card in script (0:17.8). Then a FULL outfit-change walking clip (0:19-0:23). 8 picture changes in 23 s (avg 2.9 s). The title appears at 0:23.4 (long 3.3 s dissolve) as "Episode 4: / How To Style Jeans Elegantly" over a cinematic clip, while the voice finishes the promise.

2 POINT OPENING: each section opens with a white card where the section name is written on in black script (Outerwear 3:28.9, Tops 4:28.9, Footwear 6:59.4) exactly as the narrator says "Let's start with outerwear" / "Next, let's move into tops" / "Now for the fun part, footwear". No number on the card. Before the card: the last clip of the previous section dissolves or (6:59) a white torn-paper wipe rises from the bottom. After the card: a hard cut (3:31.5) or the first product cut-out of the section (7:03.6). Inside the footwear section each shoe opens the same way: product cut-out alone on white (kitten heel 7:03, loafer 7:21, boot 7:38, sandal 7:52, flat 8:02, sneaker 8:15), then rows of women wearing it.

2b POINT CLOSE: no closing card; a section ends on its last row/clip and goes straight to the next card. The body-shape sub-points each close on a tip card (photo left + typed bullets) and open on a 3-panel row with "If your shape looks like this".
